IN MORE DETAIL

Ready-made software versus custom development

Ready-made business software provides an existing platform that can be configured for a defined workflow. HeyDock offers implementation discussions for HR, small-business ERP, ticketing, booking and appointment systems, with additional solutions assessed against your requirements. The catalogue describes solution categories; the selected product, licence and supported features are confirmed during discovery.

An implementation includes more than installing an application. Data needs to be prepared and validated, users need appropriate access, and integrations must be tested. Hosting, backups, renewals and support responsibilities should be agreed before launch. A short product demonstration is useful, but it should use representative tasks and a clear evaluation checklist.

Choose custom development when the required process is genuinely distinctive or the integration gap cannot be sensibly addressed through configuration. Choose an existing platform when its supported workflow meets the need at an acceptable total cost. The comparison should include maintenance and exit costs, not just the initial build or licence price.
